items.scope: Normalizer, shape-versus-scale minimization, radial moment assumptions, Holder lower bound and equality/uniqueness; local applicability, Gaussian and KL qualifications.
Gauge Lipschitz estimate, compactness via equicontinuity, kernel/volume closure, nonempty feasible radius.
Explicit failure of original brackets, pointwise repaired brackets and SLLN, minimizer subsequence argument; moment coupling/noise continuity.
Exact finite ellipsoid sample refutes empirical L1-radius deterministic step; empirical L2/envelope repair; final probability theorem not independently refuted.
Explicit 2D packing refutes ambient logarithmic entropy; union/cover-centre steps corrected locally; no final constrained-risk lower bound asserted.
Parameterized applications read for hypotheses and dependence on general complexity estimate; not complete certification of all imported entropy estimates.
Constant likelihood counterexample and bounded-likelihood correction; Gaussian example retained.
Downstream reconstruction performance correctly identified as further work; no full independent verification of external bibliography.

focused_independent_acceptance.scope: Existing Problems challenged against their cited source claims, admissible assumptions, counterevidence, local repairs and severity. Historical coverage items retain their original review scope; they are not a claim of a new whole-paper review.
focused_independent_acceptance.helper_attribution: Read-only supporting source/assumption challenge; no helper execution of calculations, compilation, PDF parsing, rendering or image viewing. Root made the independent acceptance judgments.
